svg.title: When a forest is cleared, animals lose food and shelter
svg.desc: A Jeju roe deer doe and her fawn walk through a living forest with berries, grass, mushrooms, a thicket and a hollow log. The forest thins into stumps, the food and shelter fade away one by one, and the pair stop together on bare, open ground under an overcast sky. Caption: No food. No shelter. Simplified: The colour grade from green to dry is a tinted overlay on the background layers, not a recolouring of each shape.

g.text: Losing that habitat can put pressure
on the species that depend on it.
